== Summary ==
Slip “•Let’s Keep A Little Optimism Here (Reflections III)” cut unchanged from page 8 of the Players Committee's [https://res.starwarsccg.org/virtual/Set-25.pdf Virtual Set 25 release sheet] (PDF file created 10 August 2025), rendered at 200 dpi (pixel box (590, 75, 1102, 360)).
